name: bank-reconciliation
description: Bank Reconciliation (SWIFT MT940 & Norma 43) for the SAP B1 Web Client

scripts.dev: concurrently -n API,WEB -c cyan,green "npm run dev --prefix packages/backend" "npm run dev --prefix packages/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run build --prefix packages/backend && npm run build --prefix packages/frontend
scripts.test: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run test --prefix packages/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build --prefix packages/shared && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/backend && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/frontend
